title: Why Britain Painted Its Warships Like Zebras
description:
In 1917, Britain painted its warships in wild stripes and zigzags on purpose. The goal was not to hide them, but to confuse a U-boat commander about a ship's speed and direction.

Sources: Britannica; Smithsonian Magazine; History.com; Hagley Museum; CIMSEC; JSTOR Daily
